text: The major of fine arts covers a wide range, including painting, sculpture, design, photography and many other fields, aiming to cultivate talents with artistic creativity, aesthetic ability and professional skills. Through the study of various art forms and expression techniques, students can master the basic laws and methods of fine arts creation and express their thoughts and emotions. The calligraphy major mainly studies the techniques, appreciation, and related creation and evaluation theories of Chinese calligraphy. It is a discipline with profound cultural heritage and unique artistic charm. It focuses on cultivating students' calligraphy skills, cultural literacy and artistic aesthetic ability, enabling students to inherit and promote Chinese calligraphy art.
